news.title: SVAGS Technologies Launches Its First Product: SVAGS Smart Car Service Platform
news.excerpt: SVAGS TECHNOLOGIES announces the launch of SVAGS, a smart car service platform available on web, Android, and iOS, connecting vehicle owners with trusted service centers.

news.title: SVAGS TECHNOLOGIES Incorporated in India
news.excerpt: We are excited to announce the incorporation of SVAGS TECHNOLOGIES, an Indian technology company with a vision to build multiple world-class software products.
